payload.name: Extract-all-items-from-enumerated-statements
payload.description: Apply during candidate extraction when a single speaker message enumerates multiple distinct durable facts of the same category (e.g., activities, events, preferences, goals); capture each listed item so no stated fact is dropped.
content: During candidate extraction, if a message lists multiple distinct durable facts of the same category (e.g., 'studying, attending workshops, and networking'), create one candidate per listed item, or a single candidate that explicitly names every listed item; do not extract only the first or most salient item.
Limit extraction to the items actually asserted in the message; do not infer additional facts, complete partial lists, or expand the enumeration beyond what the speaker stated.

solves: Extraction frequently collapses an enumerated list in one message into a single candidate that captures only the most salient item, leaving other stated durable facts missing from memory. This Skill applies when a future message explicitly lists multiple distinct facts of the same category (activities, events, preferences, goals) that all merit memory; it requires capturing each item. It must not apply to messages where listed items are illustrative examples or where only one item is asserted as a durable fact, and it does not require exhaustive expansion beyond the speaker's own enumeration.
